annotations.title: Find alternatives to a product by URL

description: Find the alternatives to a product from its website address (or its App Store, Google Play or GitHub page): the listing that address belongs to on MakerRadar and its listed alternatives, in its alternatives page's order (editors' picks, then its makers' declarations, then the rest), with what each is best for. Answers from our own catalogue — the site is never visited. A product that isn't listed yet has none; its maker can list it free.

url.description: The product's website (https://…), or its App Store, Google Play or GitHub page.

name: find_alternatives_by_url

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
